description: SwiftUI view and model for system run settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and related UI components.

classes.name: SystemRunSettingsView
classes.description: SwiftUI view for managing system run settings, including agent selection, security policies, and allowlist management.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable model managing the state and logic for system run approval settings, including agent management and allowlist operations.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistRow
classes.description: SwiftUI view representing a row in the allowlist, showing pattern details and last used info.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsTab
classes.description: Enumeration for the tabs in the settings view: policy and allowlist.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes agent list and settings for the selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously loads agent IDs and default agent from configuration store.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads approval settings for a specific agent ID.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Sets security policy and updates store accordingly.

methods.name: setAsk
methods.description: Sets ask policy and updates store accordingly.

methods.name: setAskFallback
methods.description: Sets fallback security mode and updates store.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skill CLIs and refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Validates and adds a new allowlist pattern.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing allowlist entry.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes skill bins, optionally forcing update.
